items.title: Nvidia's RTX Spark makes for an impressive Arm-based gaming laptop but not one I'd recommend you buy just for PC gaming
items.summary: The performance is there, the experience is great, but the price is utterly punitive when you compare against

content.v: Well, here it is, Nvidia's all-in-one silicon, the RTX Spark. This is an SoC that's being promoted as the everything chip; the processor that can be all things to all people. It's a creator's chip, it's an AI-lover's chip, and it's a gamer's chip.

But all three of those kinds of people do need to have one thing in common: they need to be rather well off, because this is also an expensive chip . I spoke about it when the pricing first came to light last week, while I was at the launch event for this Windows-based tech. Even the cheapest of the RTX Spark machines coming our way will cost $2,700, and that will only get you the weaker cores, a paltry 24 GB of unified memory, and a 512 GB SSD.

That is certainly a limitation, but also completely expected in a time where all things PC cost a ludicrous amount of money, especially devices which are locked into requiring a colossal amount of memory to do their main task. Which, let's be honest here, is AI.

The unified memory architecture (UMA) of the RTX Spark is perfectly suited to providing a ton of memory for system resources, but also to be able to switch that over to supporting the GPU when it comes to smashing through local AI workloads which fill up the GPU's memory pool. It's the perfect time for Nvidia to release something like this, because local AI is set for a bit of an explosion in popularity (especially when the cloud services start charging real money for their services), but it's also the worst time because this sort of memory-heavy hardware is expensive .

But here it is in front of me, an RTX Spark laptop that looks for all the world like the slimline MacBook-esque Razer Blade machines I've loved for years. But this is no Blade, this is an Asus ProArt P16 and it's a stunner. Thinner than the Zephyrus G16 with a sleek aluminium body and a 64 GB, 20-core RTX Spark N1X chip inside it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/335dER7yYLxcPPfk7AdnLL-1920-80.jpg
From the get-go I can say that this is not a platform I can really recommend to the average PC gamer

I've only been using it a short time, and there is so much to it and so much that is going to change over the next few months that I'm only really going to scratch the surface here. But today I'm going to go over the architecture and the gaming performance, and maybe I'll give you a little bit about my adventures in agentic AI as a palate cleanser later on.

Yet, even having spent under a week with an RTX Spark as my daily driver, I think from the get-go I can probably say that this is not a platform I can really recommend to the average PC gamer. It's too expensive and we're better served by the gaming laptops already on the market. But, it is an absolutely fascinating, and genuinely impressive platform, and could be a real glimpse at the future of PCs and laptops as a whole.
Nvidia RTX Spark - architecture
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/43r9NsyWuCiCCXfqYWp4eL-1920-80.jpg

I've been waiting for this moment for a long time. The promise of an all-Nvidia gaming laptop has been a tantalising prospect for years now; even before the company tried to buy Arm itself there were rumours of an SoC that would combine Arm cores with Nvidia's powerful GPU silicon.
AMD's had its own APUs for the longest time, and Intel has been running every facet of a laptop since the dark ages. So it's no surprise Nvidia wanted a piece of that pie.

And with Qualcomm taking the initial Windows-on-Arm hit with its Snapdragon Elite and Plus chips, letting the OS evolve around the early teething troubles, the time is now ripe for Nvidia's platform to come to fruition.

Actually, there is no Windows-on-Arm anymore as Microsoft is ditching the suffix and just calling it Windows, because Microsoft is all-in here, too. To be honest, I think that's largely down to the push for local AI and the fact Linux is generally where that lives right now—including the DGX Spark , which was the first desktop home of the N1X chip that's running the RTX Spark. But Microsoft is also helping on the gaming side, making the Prism emulation layer more robust on an Arm platform and also committing to bringing all the anti-cheat apps over that Linux currently doesn't have.
Though Epic is working on the Linux side of that right now.

items.title: GTA 6 发布预告片展示了杰森麻烦的过去、与露西亚的热气腾腾的淋浴场景等等
items.summary: Rockstar has released the launch trailer for GTA 6, which shows us brand new footage of Jason and Lucia as wel

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/gta-1792069832506.png
Rockstar has released the launch trailer for GTA 6 , which shows us brand new footage of Jason and Lucia as well as the open world.

The trailer, which weighs in at 1:30, touches on Jason's troubled past, which involved leaving the army not on the best of terms. We see snippets of a steamy shower scene with Lucia, who is wearing an ankle tag, and plenty of explosive open-world action.

Rather than showing gameplay, the launch trailer showcases cinematic action in GTA 6 as it nears its November 19 launch. As per Rockstar's partnership with Sony, the PS5 is prominent in the trailer, with the "plays best on PS5" message displayed at the start. The trailer confirms the footage was "captured on PS5."

The trailer begins with some narration from Jason. "I got in some trouble in the army," he begins. "Didn't leave on the best of terms. They don't give loans or anything to people like me." We see a bearded Jason working at Brian's Marina, buffing a boat before he receives a call from Lucia Caminos. Presumably this is the call Jason gets to pick up Lucia from prison.

We're shown what look like flashbacks to Jason's time in the army, where he appears to have been in the special forces. We see him wading through water as part of a military unit, and leaping out of a helicopter while on some sort of mission. But these scenes could easily be set in the "present," rather than the past, with Jason gearing up for, perhaps, a police operation. Either way, it explains why Jason is so handy with a gun.

We're then treated to various shots showing Jason and Lucia getting up to no good across Vice City, with glimpses of that steamy shower scene. The shot of Lucia wearing an ankle tag could hint at initial restrictions to exploration, as more of the world is opened up during progression through the story, but that's speculation.

This week, we learnt about GTA 6's sweat system, and there's a shot in the launch trailer that looks to show this in action. We see a man working out, and he's putting a lot of effort in. Sweat? Yep, it's all there.
"Are we gonna be okay?" Lucia asks Jason after yet more explosive shots. "We stuck together through everything," Jason replies. "Just gotta get through it."
Here's the official blurb from Rockstar on the GTA 6 launch trailer:

We also have confirmation that electronic duo Justice composed the original score for GTA 6. Indeed their track, Flower in a Hurricane, featuring fellow Grammy-winners Tame Impala and SZA along with King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, plays during the launch trailer.
It's been a busy week for GTA 6. We've got a report on what sounds like the end of Cyberleek , details of GTA 6’s sweat system , and confirmation GTA 6 is eligible for The Game Awards 2026 .

items.title: Epic said its game launcher was faster than Steam on the same day Steam got a speed boost—so I've put both to the test
items.summary: There's only seconds in it, mind.

content.v: Catching a glimpse of my screen is often a stressful experience for my colleagues. Besides my mess of desktop icons and all the browser tabs I have open at any given time, you don't want to know how many things I have set to launch on startup. Among these are, of course, the Steam and Epic Games Store clients and let me tell ya, not all launchers are created equal.

Earlier this week, Epic shared on X that it had "vibe coded the Epic Games Launcher to be faster than the other guy." On the same day, Valve released a Steam Client update that "Improved Steam Client startup performance." Well, there's only one thing for it: I've got to benchmark these bad boys to determine once and for all whose launcher is actually faster.

For my basic benchmarks, I timed how quickly each client loaded into their respective storefronts (with all images displaying properly) after I opened them from the system tray (for those curious, my rig is this iBuyPower prebuilt with an RTX 4070 Super ). I ran three tests on each and then took the average result. The Steam client loaded in 9.32 seconds on average, while the Epic Games Launcher loaded in 5.98 seconds for me.
Others have demonstrated Steam launching into the library in less time , but the Epic launcher is faster by seconds as far as my rig is concerned. That said, Steam remains my client of choice.

For instance, the first thing I noticed during my tests was that one does not simply 'exit' the Epic Games Launcher like you can with Steam. In Valve's client, you click 'Steam' in the top-left corner, then simply select 'exit' from the drop-down menu. A quick check of Task Manager shows it's not secretly running in the background.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/227BXKgc2ZKscWoxe2bNiV-1920-80.png

It's not as straightforward for Epic. You can either click the 'x' or right-click the icon in your system tray and then select 'Close window'. But for my benchmarks, I opted to 'end task' the Epic launcher each time, as just closing the window doesn't stop it from running in the background. On each of my tests, I had to do this twice as the launcher opened itself after I ended the task the first time.

This small, very specific gripe aside, there are other features on Steam I personally appreciate. The recent Big Art update has really spruced up my game library, and I've been making liberal use of the 'personal calendar' feature (Steam has already spotlighted a number of upcoming cosy and horror games, much to my wallet's chagrin).

As we've seen from my benchmarks, the Steam client is by no means perfect. For instance, Valve keeps saying it has fixed local game transfer quirks , though the experience can still be plenty quirky. I'm also not really a fan of the bouncing logo screensaver , either. And to be fair, even the features I like arguably make the client's store page look a bit cluttered. Still, I generally prefer that mess to the Epic Games Launcher's austere look myself.

items.title: Put Down Your Pitchforks, GTA 6 Was Always Eligible For The Game Awards This Year
items.summary: As we inch ever closer to the tidal wave that is Grand Theft Auto VI approaching over the horizon, some minds

content.v: As we inch ever closer to the tidal wave that is Grand Theft Auto VI approaching over the horizon, some minds are turning to awards season and how many awards Rockstar's next epic will catch in its wake. Some, like Insider Gaming, are beginning to report that--just barely-- GTA will be eligible for The Game Awards , Geoff Keighley's annual December extravaganza, which has led others to wonder if that was by some nefarious design.

The official website for The Game Awards lists November 20, 2026 at 9 PM PT as the cutoff date for this year's ceremony, which means that any game that launches before that time can be considered for nomination. As GTA VI is scheduled to launch one day earlier on November 19, that means GTA VI and TGA '26 will likely be intertwined this year.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GTA-6-Nightclub.jpg?w=636

Now, before torches are lit and pitchforks are sharpened, evidence suggests that date was not put in place specifically for GTA to be eligible this year. If anything, it was Rockstar that planned around Keighley's schedule, as the Friday before Thanksgiving has routinely been the cutoff for TGA nominations.

Last year, the cutoff was November 21, as referenced in this Polygon article regarding Dispatch's eligibility. In 2024, eligibility was cut off on November 22, as evidenced in this Polygon article exploring the games that missed 2024 and were eligible in 2025.

2018 was the last time a Rockstar project was eligible for The Game Awards, as Red Dead Redemption II landed 10 nominations and four wins. Notably, one of those wins was not Game Of The year, which went to Sony Santa Monica for the God of War reboot.

Grand Theft Auto VI's eligibility for TGA 2026 was never in doubt--well, unless it got delayed again. Now that we're likely clear of that scenario, it's only a matter of time until we see just how many trophies are headed to Vice City.

items.title: After Civ 7 stumbled, Humankind 2 looks like it's making smart choices to pick up the 4X torch
items.summary: Very dialectical.

content.v: We all know the tale of Civilization 7. It came, it saw, it had you choose a new civ at the dawn of each age and that annoyed quite a lot of people indeed. Sic transit gloria Meier-i.

So I was a bit surprised when Amplitude sat us down for a look at Humankind 2 and focused so much on its culture system, reworked from the first game, but a big part of which is selecting new cultures to embrace as the eras chug along—Egyptians becoming Berbers, or Romans, or even English (a dreadful fate) if circumstances conspire to allow it in the game's sandbox.

But I liked what I saw. The other big talking point of the hands-off demo I got was on climate and biome, and how that intersects with and shapes culture. Humankind 2's vision of history is a dialectical one, where a culture is shaped by a biome which is changed by a culture which is influenced by a biome which… you get the idea. Climate isn't static, either. Just like real life, it'll undergo natural and unnatural disruptions depending on chance and player/NPC activity.
So it all feels like an intricate and natural take on (a type of) materialist history. Just, you know, a materialist history where the Egyptians might find themselves waking up to snow one day.
The white sun of the desert

Our demo started us off looking at a map of the world—as in Earth, the actual world—dotted with numerous tribes. The interplay of environment and culture kicks off immediately: each tribe gets a "First Tale" linked to the territory in which they begin, the founding myths that act as the kernels for the full-fledged cultures that will eventually develop. They provide buffs (+X Authority, +Y Learning, and so on) and changes to tiles and citizen roles.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FUydBMcEYUMR2B3QfUCAec-1920-80.jpg

These are the things that, from the jump, make you just a little bit better at existing in your chosen environment than the other guys on the map, and that are meant to make your faction feel less like it emerged, fully-formed, from nowhere at all. We ended up with a tribe in the general vicinity of modern-day Egypt whose First Tale, appropriate enough for the banks of the Nile, was "Flood Tamer"—the upshot being that they consumed less water and were better at putting water and its generation to positive uses than average.

Amplitude says that Humankind 2's different starting biomes will have a dramatic impact on the shape of your game, especially as you start drilling down past the broad bonuses of your selected First Tale and into the more specific trees of "Adaptations" you can make to deepen your culture's affinity for its chosen biome. As Ancient Egypt, sweating in the sun of the North African desert, we could spend culture points to unlock adaptations like mudbricks, camel herding, heat endurance, and so on—various ways to adapt to the sweltering heat and scarce water of your chosen home.

Our culture and selected adaptations let us actually scrounge up some water in the African desert, but Amplitude noted that this was no reason to rest on our laurels. Climate shifts, like the actual Medieval Warm Period or Little Ice Age, can occur, turning biomes more arid or humid. Your carefully selected adaptations can be blunted by mother nature, though that's not to say it's impossible to adapt to radical change: toward the end of the demo we leapt into a save which saw Egyptian civilisation blanketed in snow, sheets of ice climbing the sides of the pyramids. Its adaptations now focused on warmth, whaling, and the long-term preservation of scarce resources.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BV5sEMYgXgb9swBbExSfdc-1920-80.jpg

The goal of all this is very Amplitude: factions that feel distinguished by more than a different aesthetic and a set of starting bonuses, and that feel uniquely tied to, and shaped by, the world around them. Having only really seen Ancient Egypt in action, I can't make any declarations as to its success, but I struggle to imagine a player starting in the Tundra, Taiga, Forest, or Brush biomes making the same moves our demo did.

Likewise, if our desert-adapted Egyptians suddenly marched into the Jungle, I get the sense they would find themselves at a serious disadvantage compared to the environment's native inhabitants. This is something you could feasibly exploit, one day. Amplitude suggested that, if you had a culture that was incredibly good at handling arid environments, you might willingly trigger some sort of nuclear apocalypse to render the whole Earth that way. Great news for you, bad news for your enemies who grew up in the snow (and for the billions of vaporised people, I suppose).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pZA47z4NoQbAetxZBtmzEc-1920-80.jpg
Culture shock

Amplitude is trying to move away from what it called "monolithic" cultures in Humankind 1—consisting of "a unity, a building, and a bonus, basically"—into something more skill-tree-based in the second game.

Every culture has a set of customs you can unlock, divided by tier, and which you equip and activate in a limited number of bonus slots. They do pretty much what you'd expect—Egypt can opt into a pharaonic tradition to buff its authority generation, or get better at wringing water from the desert sand—but it's another way the studio is trying to make each faction feel unique, tailored, and adapted specifically to its material conditions.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qnu9EpEUaByYiBCtvYfzMc-1920-80.jpg

As the eras pass by, your culture will approach "Crossroads" points, where you can decide to diverge based on either common history, shared land, or foreign contact (the first being free, the second costing culture points, and the third costing even more culture points). New cultures unlock new customs, new city aesthetics, and new roles (Humankind 2's take on a pop and job system for your cities). There are 70 cultures total, said the studio.

This did not, in the small example I was shown, seem quite as jarring as Civ 7's implementation of its own similar concept, rather it was just one way in which Amplitude is trying to make each of your sessions in the game feel different. "With Humankind 2 you will make really unique cities that won't just be the same template over and over," pledged the studio, in contrast to the first game.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FKceZ8m6YF6QC4Qh7yD3Zc-1920-80.jpg

Also a contrast to the first game: production values. Amplitude touted its new effects and animations as it played—wonders now assemble themselves bit-by-bit in dramatic fashion when completed, for instance—and talked up the game's load times even on ageing rigs. It's not the most important thing, maybe, but it does look quite nice, and makes the game feel like more of a genuine competitor to Civ, with all that series' lavishly rendered cutscenes and wonder animations.

I certainly didn't see enough of Humankind 2 to make any sweeping declarations about it or its upcoming place in the 4X canon, but I'll tell you this: I'm intrigued. Amplitude seems to be taking a lot of good lessons from both its own back catalogue and the general 4X space for Humankind 2, and I'm eager to see how they all come together when the game releases next year.

items.title: GTA 6 发布预告片展示了罪恶都市以及露西亚和杰森的性感场景
items.summary: Rockstar Games has published the launch trailer for GTA 6 , and it's pretty spectacular. The game has been in

content.v: Rockstar Games has published the launch trailer for GTA 6 , and it's pretty spectacular. The game has been in development for more than a decade, and it's finally set for release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The trailer features the new song, "Flower in a Hurricane" from Justice featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Justice also composed the entire original score for GTA 6.

The trailer itself shows off lots more of Vice City and its people, places, and criminal activities. We also see very steamy scene with Lucia and Jason in the shower. Jason and Lucia are lovers and partners in crime, and cultivating their relationship is a big part of the game. Or, you can have them break up and just be friends who commit crimes together.

The new trailer was captured on a base PS5. The trailer carries the PlayStation branding and even features an in-game controller that looks like a DualSense because Sony and Rockstar are working together to promote GTA 6.
After a decade-plus of development, GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a PC release expected in early 2027 .

items.title: GTA 6 对现实主义的追求包括一个针对特定环境的出汗系统，真正的
items.summary: Part of the reason why Rockstar has taken so long with GTA 6 comes down to the process of crafting the fine de

content.v: Part of the reason why Rockstar has taken so long with GTA 6 comes down to the process of crafting the fine details, and that includes a new sweat system.

Reporter Jason Schreier said on his YouTube page that Rockstar created a new system in GTA 6 that will make Lucia or Jason perspire different amounts "depending on how much effort they're putting in."

For example, "If they're dancing extra hard in the nightclub, they will sweat more than if they are not," he said. The sweating system is expected to also apply in other areas, like when hitting the gym or just being outside in the heat of GTA 6's version of south Florida .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Lucia_Caminos_06-1.jpg?w=636

GTA 6 is not the first game to make new strides in the area of bodily fluids, as EA Sports--many years ago--made sweat look more realistic in the Madden franchise . And years before that, 2K Sports improved the in-game sweating system in the NBA 2K series .

Rockstar also aimed for more realism in GTA 6 by going on ridealongs with police officers and visiting strip clubs . GTA 6 isn't a life-sim, though, and Rockstar took strides to find the balance between simulating life and making a fun experience .

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it's expected to be the biggest game ever. Despite that, its expected success will not fix the many deep and serious issues with the current video game market , experts say.

items.title: 皇室战争：Grand Arena 棋盘游戏独家预告片和 Kickstarter 揭晓

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/clash-royale-the-grand-arena-2-1792018106386.png
Maestro Media 最近宣布了一款改编自流行手机游戏《皇室战争》的新棋盘游戏。现在，IGN 可以独家透露，Maestro Media 将在本月启动 Kickstarter 众筹活动以支持最终产品：《皇室战争：大竞技场》
此次 Kickstarter 计划于 10 月 20 日启动，此前 Maestro 之前与 Supercell 合作的《部落冲突：史诗突袭》已成功众筹。在活动开始之前，我们有机会与桌游首席设计师 David Gordon 交谈，了解团队如何将移动热门游戏带到桌面上。
首先，我们更多地了解了棋盘游戏本身的预期，您可以在这个独家预告片中了解要点：
大竞技场通常将移动应用程序的套牌构建和策略元素改编成棋盘游戏。是的，这意味着粉丝们终于可以用真正的纸板制作《皇室战争》套牌了。
该桌面游戏专为 2 至 4 名玩家设计。每个玩家控制自己的部队，其中包括围绕所选冠军构建的八张牌。卡牌将基于手机游戏的卡牌列表，其中大量的角色和物品可以追溯到最初的《部落冲突》时代。

In-game, players take turns to try and destroy other players’ Towers while also protecting their own. The board features two lanes, and players must determine where exactly to play cards to launch attacks, plant defensive units, and use items. Players can’t endlessly cycle through their cards, either, as moves are limited by the classic Clash resource, Elixir.
Destroying another player’s Tower nets you a Crown, and the player with the most Crowns at the end wins.
Sound familiar? It should - at least to Clash Royale fans. Maestro Media put some serious thought into translating the mobile gameplay to the tabletop.

We asked the game’s lead designer, David Gordon, about how the team approached the game’s design, and learned the process took some trial and error: “We tried mechanisms such as actual real time play against a clock, putting out a bunch of cubes, and simultaneous reveals, as well as various strategies to minimize the admin for players. Ultimately, we found that focusing on elixir spending in a turn-based card play system yielded a fun experience that most resembled that of the video game.”

That said, the team behind The Grand Arena was weary of designing a game that would only appeal to die-hard Clash fans. Over the course of the game’s development, they play-tested The Grand Arena with both Clash veterans and people who had no experience with the Supercell franchise. In Gordon’s words, “It was important that a strategy game fan who had never played the video game would find the tabletop version fun - and hopefully even inspire them to try the video game!”
Grand Arena 将加入 Maestro Media 之前发布的《部落冲突：史诗突袭》的行列，该游戏于 2025 年在 Kickstarter 上成功获得支持，现在可在亚马逊和 Target 等零售商处购买。

items.title: Humankind 2 Rethinks One of Its Predecessor’s Most Divisive Ideas
items.summary: Humankind 2 takes a new approach to the monolithic cultures versus culture-switching debate, and could provide

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/humankind2-firstpreview-blogroll-1792057928530.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

Historical 4X games tend to focus on a group of people you might call a nation, an empire, or indeed, a civilization. Amplitude's Humankind series is no different, but its upcoming second entry is looking at these concepts from a slightly different angle. After all, the idea of a shared identity comes from the stories we tell ourselves and each other about who we are as much as anything. And that is the starting point for charting a course through the ages in Humankind 2.

While the original Humankind and other staples of the genre typically begin with choosing a specific historical culture like the Greeks or the Egyptians, Humankind 2 is a bit different. The first choice you will make is between one of what I counted to be 19 different founding myths based on real-world oral traditions, each of which corresponds to at least one historical culture. This is the tale of how your people came to be, in their own minds.

We caught a glimpse of the Wild Twins origin, which gives bonuses for settling near wild animals and is associated with the Etruscans, and the Flood Tamers, which is ideally suited for fertile river valleys and is associated with the Ancient Egyptians. The hands-off demo we saw was using Humankind 2's new Historical Mode, which is set on a non-randomized map of Earth and placed each of these starter cultures in the region they are from in real life. Of course, this won't be the only way to play, with randomized worlds also being an option.

While the first Humankind shook up the genre by forcing you to pick a new culture in each of its six eras, a choice made even more controversial when it showed up in Civilization 7, Humankind 2 does not make this mandatory. It will have more than 70 cultures at launch spread out over the eras, but you can pick one at the very dawn of history and stick with it to the end. Each culture has an era or a set of eras in which it can be selected for the first time. Ancient Egypt, for example, can be selected in the first or second era. But if you already are that culture, you will never be forced to abandon it.

It may eventually make sense to do so for you. Amplitude mentioned you might get a choice to pick "a different culture associated with Egypt" in the later eras. But even keeping the "Ancient" Egyptians alive into modern times won't mean your culture stays completely static due to how you assemble a society out of different bonuses.
Brick by Brick

Each of the more than 70 cultures has their own specific customs tree to pull from. In the case of Ancient Egypt, this includes staples like Embalming, Hieroglyphics, and the office of the Pharaoh. These slot into what was, at least initially, 10 tradition slots that can be active at any one time. These can be pulled from any of the cultures you've played as throughout the run. So even if you choose to become the Carthaginians in the second era, you could keep the Pharaoh tradition active as long as you want.

There are even two special slots, called Legacies, which are rewards for completing a culture's tree. Each culture lets you pick one of two possible legacies to carry forward, which are more powerful than normal traditions. For Ancient Egypt, these are Scale of Eternity, which cements your people's legacy of monumental architecture, and Conquering Dynasty, which sets you on a path of military expansion in the name of the God-King.

So what does that mean for rulers who want to keep the same culture all game? Well, historical cultures are not the only way to gain new traditions. Another major source is Adaptations, which are earned based on where your civilization is located. An Egyptian player who settles in the desert will get access to different adaptations than one that settles in the Arctic, even though they will share the Ancient Egypt tradition tree in common. On top of this, you can also adopt a limited number of traditions from cultures you come into contact with through acculturation, allowing your society to keep advancing with the times based on what your neighbors are doing.

If you do want to pick a new culture at the start of a new era, there are a few more restrictions on that now than the original game's first-come, first-served free-for-all. You’ll initially get a choice of cultures with which yours have a real-world shared history. For Ancient Egypt, their natural progression for Era 2 is the Persians. Second, you can pick a culture with shared geography. If you're playing Ancient Egypt in their historical starting position, this includes the Berbers (also available as an Era 1 pick) or the Carthaginians. And finally, you can adopt the culture of another group you have come into contact with in the current era. We were shown Egypt able to become the Goths.
Against the Elements

While you attempt to build a culture that can withstand the ages, Mother Earth herself won't be sitting idly by. Nature's role in history is seeing a renewed emphasis in Humankind 2, including mechanics for natural and human-caused climate change. We were shown, for example, that shifts in the global climate like the Medieval Warming Period or the Little Ice Age might cause whole biomes to shift in character. Plains regions which began as humid might suddenly become arid, changing their resource potentials and potentially leading to instability. Technology can begin to influence this in both directions in the later eras.

Aside from all this fresh flash, Humankind 2 looks like a fairly recognizable historical 4X game. We didn't get to dig too deep into the fine details of the mechanics, but the familiar resources of Money, Food, Production, Knowledge, Faith, and Authority were all visible in the UI. The stylized 3D map looks great, if a bit cramped on the Historical Earth version. Cities will dominate regions rather than acquiring individual tiles, like in most of Amplitude's other games. And elevation is still clearly visible.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/01-humankind-2-city-1792057671310.jpg

Notably, in the demo we saw of Historical Mode, there were no empty regions by the end of Era 1. I was told the Neolithic phase is still part of the journey, but areas of the map you don't settle in right away will end up populated with their historical cultures fairly quickly, forcing you to expand by conquest or diplomacy rather than settling virgin fields.

Some other cultures we saw included the Romans and the Thule people of the prehistoric Arctic. Other Era 1 starting locations visible on the Historical Mode map, though we didn't get to see their names, included the Yucatan Peninsula, Northern Mexico, the American Great Lakes, Britain, Scandinavia, Southern France, Greece, the Carpathian Basin, West Africa, Central Africa, Mesopotamia, the Altai Mountains, the eastern shore of the Caspian Sea, and China's Yangtze River.
March of Progress

Cities seem to be following the "unpacked" model of most recent 4X games, sprawling across many tiles. A brief glimpse of modern Paris showed an urban footprint covering most of the region. I raised a concern about this since I don't particularly like it when the whole map is covered in buildings by the endgame. I prefer some areas to stay wild or rural in appearance to contrast the urban centers. And I was assured by Amplitude that there will be incentives not to blanket everything in concrete.

items.title: Trollheim: Gnomes Aims to Bring the Mystery and Whimsy of Nordic Folklore to a Survival Crafting Game
items.summary: Trollheim: Gnomes, a new survival crafting game for PC based on Nordic folklore that IGN announced as part of

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/trollheimgnomes-2026-10-12-6-1791907649112.png

Trollheim: Gnomes, a new survival crafting game for PC based on Nordic folklore that IGN announced as part of IGN Fan Fest, comes from a team of ex-Mojang developers who all grew up playing in the Nordic woods and hearing folk tales of Sprýg Gnomes and other creatures and want to make a game about it. I got an early look at it, and there's one key thing that might set it apart in a very, very crowded genre: combat is optional.

You'll gather building materials and as you level up, you'll be able to not only craft more and more intricate and complex structures, but you'll able to do so higher and higher up in the trees. It might be best thought of like living in a dark-forest version of a condo high-rise: the best unit is the penthouse. And you will run into opposition in the form of the Väsen, who are signficantly larger than your three-inch-tall gnome. All of that sounds pretty run-of-the-mill, right? But that's where the combat-optional hook comes in. The Väsen won't attack you on sight. They will if you antagonize them, but intriguingly, you can also befriend them by bringing them food or other items they need.

"If you want to hang out and make it cozy, that's up to you, said game director Jojje Dalunde. "You will always be able to achieve the same goals using a friendly approach as you would a hostile approach." Added studio founder Bjorne Larson, "We want combat to feel intentional. It's an opt-in. You will always know that you're stepping into something you might not be able to handle. You will be able to just enjoy your time with your friends and live the cozy experience of being this tiny Sprýg Gnome."

Adding to the cozy-if-you-want-it-to-be appeal of Trollheim are two welcome features: co-op and procedural generation. No matter how many people play with you (the max in one world is eight players), the Dark Forest – which the developers call a "main character" in Trollheim – will procedurally generate every time you start a new game, which should help the woods always feel new and mysterious.

But even if you don't opt in to combat, you'll still have to survive. Cold, wetness, and hunger are all very real threats to contend with. though your crafting extends beyond just housing. You can also make things like wingsuits to help you get around the Dark Forest more quickly and easily. You've got a single life bar to worry about that incorporates health and stamina into one meter for you to manage. I also saw some stealth elements in the hands-off demo I was presented, which made me happy to see.

Again, it won't be easy for Trollheim: Gnomes to stand out in the glut of its fellow survival crafting games. But the developers are, if nothing else, committed to building out their world. In addition to a Trollheim video game, they're constructing "an interconnected narrative that spans books, games, collectibles, film and lifestyle." The first of those transmedia experiences is a 288-page book available now called Trollheim: Tale of Sýstir. You can wishlist Trollheim: Gnomes on Steam if you're interested.

items.title: A co-op survival game where trolls aren't just there to be killed? 'We don't talk about them as enemies, but rather as neighbors'
items.summary: What kind of neighbor will you be in Trollheim: Gnomes?

others.title: GTA 6 Reviews: When They Could Be Released

content.v: A deep forest of towering trees can be an intimidating place, especially if you're only three inches tall. In co-op PvE survival game Trollheim: Gnomes , you're a wee little Sprýg Gnome looking for a new place to call home after Oden has driven you from Midgård.

That home is a dense, dark forest, and you're not the only one seeking refuge there. In addition to foraging, exploring, building your home, and dealing with survival systems like cold and hunger, your gnome will have to contend with other residents of the forest, which the Trollheim devs call väsen.

Väsen can be faeries, sirens, and you guessed it, trolls. But unlike the trolls in another 'heim I could name , Trollheim's trolls aren't just there to ruin your day with a well-swung tree trunk or to be defeated for their resource drops.

"When we talk about our NPCs, we don't talk about them as enemies, but rather as neighbors," said Jojje Dalunde, game director at Off-leash Interactive. "Because that's really what they are, and as you know, you can have good neighbors and you can have bad neighbors. In this game, you as a player get to choose if you are going to be a good neighbor or a bad neighbor. And the väsen in this world will react to how you interact with them and how you behave."

In the presentation, the trolls didn't look particularly friendly, yelling warnings at gnomes who go too close, throwing things at them, and swinging their fists. But that doesn't necessarily make them bad guys, does it? Maybe the gnome is on their turf, intruding on their homeland, and maybe this troll hasn't had great interactions with gnomes in the past.

Of course, it's your choice: if you want to attack the väsen instead of befriending them you can… but isn't the idea of making friends with the so-called "monsters" a fun one? (If I could give gifts to the trolls in Valheim, I definitely would. Anything to stop them from raiding my base.)

If you accidentally (or purposefully) make an enemy of one of your neighbors, it's not the end of the world, either. "There are ways to befriend väsen that you may have crossed," Dalunde said. "So if you were a bad neighbor, there are ways to make amends for it and find common ground."

The base-building looks nice, as your tiny gnomes can climb the towering trees and build elegant little homes amidst their thick trunks and long branches, then connect them with ziplines. Your glider? It's a leaf or a few feathers, because you're very small. You get the picture. Trollheim: Gnomes is coming to early access later this year.

items.title: Xbox Ally X 20 vs Xbox Ally X: A wickedly bright OLED screen and frosty temps make for a begrudgingly attractive upgrade for the Asus handheld
items.summary: All that glitters might actually be gold.

content.v: So, you've seen the Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 in all its black and gold glory and wondered if it's worth paying $300 more for it. Well, the answer is 'it really depends on what kind of device you are looking for' and 'how much is a fresh OLED screen worth to you?'

Unlike the other ROG 20th anniversary edition bits of Asus gear, the X20 is not about superfluous add-ons (unless you pick up the bundle with XR glasses). You aren't getting a commemorative faceplate here, or extra stickers. You get an OLED screen, TMR thumbsticks, improved thermals, and MicroSD Express compatibility.
You also get Impulse triggers, which means they can rumble independently, and the D-Pad can be flicked around to make the corners more or less pronounced.

The screen is perhaps the biggest sell here, with its 1400 HDR-certified display going up to a peak brightness of 1,400 nits. As I found in my review , it's so sizzlingly bright at points that I looked at the sun in Cyberpunk 2077 while lying in bed one night and actually winced. Check out the full differences below.

others.title: GTA 6 Will Make The Game Awards Cutoff Date for Eligibility by the Skin of Its Teeth, Confirming It Has a Chance at 2026 Game of the Year

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/vintage-vice-city-pack-exclusive-looks-02-1792065796840.jpg
GTA 6 is officially in with a chance of winning the 2026 Game of the Year award at this year’s The Game Awards, after the show confirmed the cutoff date for eligibility.

According to a FAQ on The Game Awards website , to be in with a chance of winning an award a game must be released on or before Friday, November 20, 2026. GTA 6’s release date is currently November 19, 2026, which means it’s made the cutoff date by just a single day.
Here’s the official blurb:

Nominations for this year’s awards haven’t been announced yet, of course, but it’s hard to imagine a situation where GTA 6 doesn’t show up for most, if not all, the categories it’s eligible for. Sandfall Interactive's Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 holds the world record for the most wins at The Game Awards , taking home a whopping nine awards at last year's show. Will GTA 6 beat it?

And given GTA Online 2 or whatever the multiplayer mode ends up being called is reportedly due out next year, perhaps alongside a PC version , we could see GTA 6 back in contention at The Game Awards 2027.

While we wait for this year's nominations, we’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 for you to check out, including our in-depth interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson , our report on what sounds like the end of Cyberleek , and confirmation of GTA 6’s sweat system .

items.title: IGN 10分神作 女版乔布斯纪录片 硅谷惊天骗局主人公
items.summary: A24出品美国纪录片《你能看到一切》（You Can See Everything）将于10月16日在北美正式公映。IGN为本片打出十分满分好评。

content.v: A24出品美国纪录片《你能看到一切》（You Can See Everything）将于10月16日在北美正式公映。IGN为本片打出十分满分好评。
《你能看到一切》由内森·菲尔德、兰斯·奥本海姆联合执导。主角是伊丽莎白·霍姆斯 (Elizabeth Holmes，美国医疗科技公司 Theranos 创始人、轰动一时的“硅谷惊天骗局”主角)影片记录Theranos创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯在入狱前34天邀请摄制组记录其生活，并历时三年追踪她与伴侣比利·埃文斯的日常，原本的人物特写逐渐演变为对真实、欺骗与镜头伦理的探讨。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152055037420.png
“女版乔布斯”曾是她最著名的称号。她刻意模仿苹果创始人史蒂夫·乔布斯，总是穿着标志性的黑色高领毛衣，追求极简主义，并频繁登上各类主流科技与财经媒体的封面。
IGN 10分 ：杰作（编辑之选）
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152052303870.png
《你能看到一切》是一部令人惊叹、深入私密领域的调查纪录片。电视节目主持人内森·菲尔德（Nathan Fielder）试图从硅谷诈骗者伊丽莎白·霍姆斯那双深邃的蓝眼睛中，寻找那些令人费解的问题的答案。
总评：
在《你能看到一切》中，一股势不可挡的力量遇上了一个难以撼动的目标——内森·菲尔德对硅谷诈骗者伊丽莎白·霍姆斯展开调查。
这部体量宏大、情感充沛的纪录片由菲尔德与《黄金时段》（Primetime）的导演兰斯·奥本海姆（Lance Oppenheim）联合执导。影片通过令人窒息的近距离特写和出人意料的情景再现，勾勒出一个令人同情的人物形象。然而，她的表现究竟源于否认现实、陷入妄想，还是刻意表演，试图让观众相信她属于前两者之一？影片并未轻易给出答案。

items.summary: 近日，美妆网红赤木刚宪自曝一年从220斤暴瘦近100斤，伴随月经停止与情绪崩溃。

content.v: 近日，美妆网红赤木刚宪自曝一年从220斤暴瘦近100斤，伴随月经停止与情绪崩溃，她坦言这一过程“几乎达到人类极限”且“违背人性”，却霸气回击外界对其减重方式的质疑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261011_zy_red_164_20/184.jpg
赤木刚宪自述巅峰体重达220斤，在一年内通过高强度训练与清淡饮食，减重近100斤，她形容成果已触及自身“极限”。减重过程伴随强烈生理与心理代价。高强度运动让她时常反胃，甚至导致月经停止、情绪崩溃，她曾透露自己“半年没有掉过秤”，经历了漫长的平台期与体重反弹后才再度突破。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261011_zy_red_164_20/1222.jpg
其训练包含跑步、墙球、划船机等综合功能性项目。她曾咬牙完成高强度的HiROCKS比赛，以一小时28分59秒完赛，展现了超越常人的毅力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261011_zy_red_164_20/1292.jpg
针对外界关于“打针”“抽脂”等走捷径的说法，她坚定驳斥，强调减重成果完全源于真实训练，直言“你打针能打出直角肩来？”她认为好身材是生命力的体现，主张审美多元，并对所有成功减重者表示尊重，因为减肥本身就违背人性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261011_zy_red_164_20/1401.jpg

content.v: 随着《 赛博朋克 2》的开发持续推进，游戏总监Gabe Amatangelo分享了更多关于《 赛博朋克2077 》续作的想法，以及随着CD Projekt Red投入更多人手，他的计划是如何演变的。
在一篇新的博文中，Amatangelo谈到了赛博朋克主题对他而言的意义，并表示他想探索非人化的概念。随着更多人加入《赛博朋克2》的开发，Amatangelo解释说，随着更多人将自己的想法融入其中，这个项目正逐渐成为参与者的“反映”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792067565_362585_jpg_r.jpg
“最初我构思的是《赛博朋克2》，但随着更多人的加入，它也在不断演变。随着我赋予团队及其成员更多自主权，让他们贡献力量，它也在不断演变。它会变成别的东西，对吧?它会变成我精心打造的作品，但最终它反映了团队的内心和灵魂。我期待着与大家分享这一切。”
阿马坦杰洛补充道，由于电子游戏对他的人生影响巨大，他希望它们能够继续影响那些沉浸于这些数字世界的人们。
“电子游戏影响了我的人生。它们开拓了我的视野，激励着我，让我充满激情。我希望这种影响能够延续到这一代和下一代。”
目前还没有《赛博朋克2》何时发售的消息。它是CD Projekt Red正在开发的几个大型项目之一。公司还计划从《巫师4》开始，在六年内推出完整的《巫师》三部曲。CD Projekt Red也希望别再出现《赛博朋克2077》首发时的灾难情况：这款游戏刚推出时有很多问题和bug，花了好几个月才修好。
《赛博朋克2077》在那几个月里改善了很多。此后几年，它又获得了大量免费的发售后更新，还推出了广受评论界好评的资料片《往日之影》。不过，当初问题重重的首发仍然严重损害了CD Projekt Red的声誉。
那么现在呢?《赛博朋克2077》已经是一款相当出色、值得入手的游戏。它至今仍卖得很好，尤其是在大幅打折时。衍生动画《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季将于10月20日开播，可能会让更多人重新关注这款游戏。此外，派拉蒙还宣布正在制作一部《赛博朋克2077》电影。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Epic和Steam“打起来了”！V社反手更新直接反超
items.summary: Epic近期推出了改版后的Epic Games启动器预览版，并公开强调其性能提升，甚至直接拿竞争对手Steam作比较，宣称新版启动器的启动速度…

content.v: Epic近期推出了改版后的Epic Games启动器预览版，并公开强调其性能提升，甚至直接拿竞争对手Steam作比较，宣称新版启动器的启动速度更快。没想到，Valve很快便通过Steam客户端更新作出回应。
据Epic公布的数据，新版启动器在冷启动状态下进入商店页面仅需5.47秒，而Steam此前需要10.07秒，Epic据此宣称启动速度快了46%。此外，从系统托盘恢复至游戏库页面时，新版Epic Games启动器也比Steam快14%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152022496426.png
不过，Valve似乎并不打算就此认输。近日发布的Steam客户端更新带来了多项改进，包括大屏幕模式优化和大量问题修复，其中最引人关注的是客户端启动性能的提升。
有网友分享的视频显示，更新后的Steam客户端启动时间缩短至5.23秒，相较此前的10.07秒几乎缩短了一半，也快于Epic公布的5.47秒。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/origin_202610152023114441.gif
这场启动速度的较量也让两家平台的竞争再次成为焦点。近年来，Epic Games一直试图通过免费游戏等方式吸引玩家，但Steam凭借多年来积累的用户基础和丰富的功能，依然在PC游戏市场占据重要地位。相比之下，Epic启动器在功能完善程度等方面仍被部分玩家认为存在差距。
需要注意的是，上述启动时间来自特定测试及用户分享的视频，实际表现可能受到硬件配置、系统环境和测试条件等因素影响，不能直接代表所有设备上的运行结果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152023315567.png

items.title: Sony Reminds PlayStation Plus Subscribers That GTA 5 Leaves the Library 2 Days Before GTA 6 Comes Out
items.summary: PS5 and PS4 players taking advantage of PS Plus to play GTA 5 and GTA Online better get their hours in because

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/ultimate-edition-vice-city-style-01-1791974913899.jpg

PS5 and PS4 players taking advantage of PS Plus to play GTA 5 and GTA Online better get their hours in because their days are numbered. GTA 5 is being removed from the PS Plus catalogue just two days before GTA 6’s launch in November.

GTA 5 has sold an eye-watering 230 million copies since its 2013 launch, so you'd imagine most who are interested in experiencing Rockstar’s sweeping and beautiful take on Los Angeles have already done so. But if you’re one of the few who hasn't, you have until November 17 to get it done via PS Plus.
Sony has been warning PS5 players about the change. “If you’re counting down the days until GTA 6 arrives on PS5 on November 19, why not take a trip to Los Santos in the meantime?” the message said .

“GTA 5 is available to play in the Game Catalog for PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium members, but only until November 17. So whether you’ve yet to experience the tale of Franklin, Michael, and Trevor, or want to revisit it before Jason and Lucia’s Vice City story begins, now’s the time.”
The popup was followed by a prompt to preorder GTA 6 . It’s just another example of how huge Rockstar’s sequel will be, and what an impact it will have on game sales for platform holders like Sony.

Expected to be the most expensive video game of all time , GTA 6 is likely to make that money back fairly quickly. Even actors like Game of Thrones’ Kit Harington have said he’s excited for GTA 6 , despite not being a gamer.

Rockstar developers traveled across Florida on GTA 6 research trips to portray the state as authentically as possible in its satire-laden recreation of Miami and the surrounding areas. CBS news recently did a segment on GTA 6 , astonished by how accurately the game captures the city.

Elsewhere, the Australian government put out a graphic that informed citizens of their rights for requesting time off work when GTA 6 launches next month. In the meantime, Rockstar has been taking over Miami in its big marketing push leading up to launch.

But some Miami officials have expressed concern over the studio’s influence, with Rockstar promoting GTA 6 on the iconic Goodyear blimp, and collaborating with local NBA team the Miami Heat . There’s no stopping this train, which pulls into the station when GTA 6 launches for PS5 and Xbox Series consoles on November 19.

items.title: 国行苹果AI 12月上线！最老支持到这款iPhone

content.v: 鸭的老15 Pro在生命末期，终于拿下AI大结果了？？？
最近，国行iPhone的AI又有新消息： iPhone 15 Pro、15 Pro Max及后续支持机型，已经在9月29日的国行备案换证中，增加了搭载的大模型备案编号。
新增的模型名称是Apple智能、通义万相、通义千问。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906631.jpg
图片来源：IT之家
拿着老Pro等AI的朋友，排着队终于等到AI的号码牌🎵
苹果官方表示： 当Apple智能在中国大陆推出时，之前购买的支持设备，将能激活并使用“一系列核心功能”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906635.jpg
Apple智能旁边，站着通义万相和通义千问。国行苹果AI的合作进展，已经具体到了许可证上的编号。
至于千问，也不只是名字出现在截图里。
7月15日，阿里巴巴直接向证券时报回应，千问将作为AI能力集成到Apple智能，为中国用户提供文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力，覆盖iOS、iPadOS、macOS和visionOS。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906634.jpg
最重要的是，用户无需在应用之间切换。
毕竟，如 果每次都得把文字复制出来、切到另一个App、等答案、再复制回去，那对已经会用AI应用的人来说，实在算不上多大惊喜。
系统集成真正值得期待的，是处理眼前内容时少折腾几步，少一点阻碍～
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906632.gif
那到底还要等多久？
彭博记者Mark Gurman最新援引知情人士称， 苹果计划在12月，随着iOS 27.3更新，在中国大陆推出Apple智能。
不过，即使按这个时间表推出，也不等于海外所有AI功能一次性搬过来。
MacRumors援引彭博报道指出， 预计首批将包含照片编辑等基础功能，文本生成工具会有限制；Image Playground、新版Genmoji，以及新版Siri AI，暂不在这次推出的范围内。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906633.jpg
这就有点尴尬了，全新一代Siri AI算是苹果追赶安卓友商AI的关键功能。
按苹果的介绍，Siri AI可以结合个人语境、理解屏幕上的内容，并跨App执行操作。
帮你修一下照片，和理解你正在看什么、替你跨应用办事真比不了，大伙还是尽量放低期待吧。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906636.gif
同一时间，苹果的新硬件倒是挺忙。
10月14日，库克在微博上展示了爱奇艺为iPhone Duo做的观看体验，还夸对方的App优化“十分出色”。
从表现来看，当Duo折成悬停状态后，立起来的那一半播放视频，平放的那一半可以控制进度、暂停、画质、弹幕和亮度。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906637.jpg
图片来源：微博 @TimCook
Duo的首组曝光跑分也来了。
MacRumors将Geekbench里型号为iPhone19,4的记录识别为iPhone Duo，单核3986分，多核11067分，与iPhone 18 Pro系列多组成绩接近。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_6233492_4906638.jpg
新从目前的表现来看，起码在适配和性能这块，对Duo就没啥好担心的了～

items.title: 最丑的2B诞生了！四处联动的下场

content.v: 转载自微信公众号：手游姬
众所周知，在游戏领域里总是会有些游戏虽然不出续作，但各种联动却非常勤快的存在，让人怀疑这些制作人是不是特别沉迷这种躺着赚钱的感觉。《尼尔：机械纪元》就可以算是一个例子，各位姬友还记得它联动过多少作品么？就在前几天，它宣布联动《黎明杀机》。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_11132880_4906831.jpg
本次联动内容其实就是三款皮肤，其中2B和A2出的是幸存者阵营的皮肤，这就让人非常好奇按照这俩姑的战斗力，到底是啥样的鬼才能把她俩吊起来。鬼阵营的联动皮肤是埃米尔……结合这家伙的战力以及隐藏BOSS的身份，当鬼还真是离谱中透着合理。
就是不知道远在天国的尼尔本人和凯宁看到埃米尔呼哧呼哧追杀别人会作何感想。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_11132880_4906826.jpg
当然了，如果就只是以上情况的话我肯定不可能单写一篇文章来吐槽，它必然还有其他的槽点，简单来说就是……这次的2B实在是太丑了，堪比线上约美女网友面基结果来的是个穿着COS服的大叔。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_11132880_4906827.jpg
X上有不少网友的意见都和我类似。甚至于还有网友把这2B皮肤的眼罩拆下来之后发现……好消息是这张脸真不能说像是大叔，坏消息则是比起大叔也没好看多少。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_11132880_4906829.jpg
玩家群体直接进入了吐槽模式，也有人发出了“为啥欧美厂商联动日式女角色时，总能整出一种说不清道不明的性转感”这种灵魂质问。不过我觉得这次他们还真不是故意恶心人，毕竟众所周知杀鸡这游戏角色建模一直都偏写实，带不起来2B那种纤细修长、带点不真实美感的日式角色设计也是正常。
风格割裂可以理解，但做成这样，恐怕不能全甩锅给审美差异。毕竟同批次的A2皮肤，社区评价就相对平稳。至于埃米尔更没啥槽点，在做怪物这方面杀鸡的水平基本在线，就只是对于玩过《尼尔》系列的人来说，看到埃米尔追人多少有点诡异。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_11132880_4906830.jpg
官方的态度倒是让人非常满意。在铺天盖地的差评之后，社区经理直接出来表示开发团队已经开始对2B的皮肤进行重做调整，预计会随着之后的BUG修复补丁推出，虽说具体时间没有公开，但他们却已经放出话来说要提升皮肤对于原作形象的还原度。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/15/origin_11132880_4906828.jpg
只可惜，因为两部作品风格差异较大，我觉得他们再怎么调整也很难达到原作中的味道。但无论如何联动翻车之后官方愿意认错并着手修改，态度总归比某些厂商装死到底要强不少。
所以姬友们玩杀鸡么？对于这次的联动是否感兴趣呢？如果已经掏了钱的话，等到官方修改完记得来跟我说一声修改成果如何。

items.title: 'There is no secret sauce' to a successful live service game according to Overwatch's associate game director, but knowing your audience is a good start
items.summary: "We occupy this really unique spot in the middle."

others.title: PGS 10 Winners Stage is LIVE!!

content.v: Not many live service games have stood the test of time quite like Overwatch . 10 years in and it's still been able to retain its playerbase, maintain momentum, and even ramp it up. How, you ask? Well, besides having really cute skins and a very enticing game loop, Team 4 figured out exactly where Overwatch needed to stand years ago.
"Overwatch exists in an incredibly competitive space among live service shooters," Overwatch's game director Aaron Keller tells me. "Some of the biggest games in the world are here."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jkRdksMSaxqGoauCPv8jkD-1920-80.png

To have (and crucially, maintain) a successful live service game is the golden goose egg of this industry right now. With publishers like Sony trying to force it upon countless studios before pulling the plug on eight out of 12 projects when things start to go sideways. Even games that manage to land with an eager audience like Arc Raiders can struggle to maintain momentum. But for some, like Overwatch, the live service model has worked, so what's the secret?

"That's a big question," associate game director Alec Dawson says. "I think some of the things we've learned is to shut away fear as much as possible and push beyond, experiment within that experience. But what it really boils down to is coming to work each morning and making good decisions every day. We've lived that over the last two years." But unfortunately for any eager Sony execs reading this, "there's no secret sauce in particular."

"It's incredibly hard to make something that players can interact with every day for years on end," Keller adds. "You can get 95% of the way there, and your game could still die three months after release. It is much, much harder to come up with that initial sort of experience than I think a lot of people give it credit for. But once you've done it, you've kind of just started the race."

Free time and cash are both at a premium for most players, and with so many options available, games studios need to offer up exactly what they're looking for. Because if they don't, someone else will.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xAPcJQWTXPH6qy4e7Wjeeg-1920-80.jpg

"Our players really want novelty and they really want variety, but they want it inside of a competitive framework," Keller explains. "If you look at other games on the market, there's ones that are really just more about the novelty side of the game, and there's other ones that are really just about straight up competition. There's not a lot of change in those games. We occupy this really unique spot in the middle."

Marvel Rivals came the closest to taking Overwatch's spot, but that didn't last long as it cemented itself as a casual game which is more concerned with balancing for fun . Alternatively, Overwatch offers higher skill ceilings and a "sense that your time was worthwhile in the experience," Dawson explains. "That the rules and structure of the sport were fair towards the outcome."

This isn't to say that Team 4 have uncovered the secret to perfect game balancing, I'm not sure that'll ever be possible, but the idea still stands that players should be able to take away some kind of lesson from each game, lessons that'll help form them into a more skilled player. Even if that lesson is to 'don't solo queue at 2 am'.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PTJNn6U2t7PhpamQWpCfQn-1920-80.jpg

"There's a design value at Blizzard called control is king," Keller adds. The idea that players want to feel like they're in control of everything their hero does and therefore experience the cool moments that come from that. Overwatch's newest hero Doctrine is "a powerful example of something like that."
I can't wait for players to see some of the archetypes that are coming next season, and especially Season 1 next year.
Aaron Keller, Game Director

Doctrine offers two experiences: a primal and slightly simplistic one in which it feels good to just use his base kit to land shots. Then there's a more nuanced version, which offers players the chance to raise the skill ceiling with his Infuse mechanic.

"It's so satisfying to be holding down Infuse while you're trying to line up your shot, as the beam gets bigger, you get that sound effect, then you pull the trigger, and you see that connection. It's so satisfying. The hero team, and the audio team, the VFX animations, everybody kind of comes together to have that one moment where control really is king. That moment just needs to feel as good and as visceral as possible."

Doctrine is the only hero I've played since the new season came out last week, and I can confirm his kit is just as good as Keller makes it sound. It's a testimony to Team 4 that 54 heroes later they're still able to offer players something that feels unique, specialised, and just a hell of a lot of fun to play.

"One of the Blizzard greats, Chris Metzen, always described our company as a hero factory," Keller says. "This is just what we do, and you can see it in a lot of our other games, from StarCraft to Warcraft to Diablo, just all these characters that are really larger than life. It's what our fans can really throw their passion behind.

"I think that Overwatch really carries that torch forward. We're trying to make these amazing fantasies that people can just jump into and live out. I can't wait for players to see some of the archetypes that are coming next season, and especially Season 1 next year."

content.v: 2026年游戏大奖的悬念，很大程度上取决于《GTA6》到底能不能参评。《GTA6》这款游戏可能拿下它获得提名的大多数奖项。现在可以确定，按目前的发售日期，它刚好赶得上参评截止时间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792066447_643160_jpg_r.jpg
游戏大奖的流程很长，排场也大，但它已经是游戏界规模最大的颁奖之夜。观看人数和盈利能力似乎都在逐年增长。如果《GTA6》参加今年的评选，颁奖礼可能会更热闹。
来看看2026年游戏大奖关于“参评截止日期”的说明：
“游戏必须在太平洋时间2026年11月20日星期五晚9点或之前正式向消费者发售。‘玩家之声’类别的游戏必须在2026年11月30日或之前发售。”
如今大多数人都知道，《GTA6》终于要在11月19日发售了。它不会再次延期，尤其不会在这么晚的时候延期;就连那一长串令人疲惫的《GTA6》泄露消息，此时也无法让这款游戏偏离轨道。
2026年是游戏表现较好的一年，我们已经有了不少好游戏。但《GTA6》的加入可能会重创其他作品的获奖机会：《生化危机9》《控制：共振》《大步同行》《极限竞速：地平线6》《挖掘者米娜》《宝可梦：Pokopia》，以及许多其他游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792066442_858484_jpg_r.jpg
除非《GTA6》不知怎么成了一场灾难性的失败，否则它要是拿不到几个奖，才会令人震惊。那么《GTA6》会打破《光与影：33号远征队》在游戏大奖上创下的纪录吗?
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: VTuber 世界正在发生极其混乱的事情
items.summary: If you've ever wondered what would happen if you put an AI VTuber, her evil twin, their creator, a cow, an imp

content.v: If you've ever wondered what would happen if you put an AI VTuber, her evil twin, their creator, a cow, an imp, and a monkey in a car in a post-apocalyptic desert and told them to drive thousands of kilometers, congratulations. You've got the same brain as Vedal987 , the creator of Neuro-Sama and her twin, Evil.

The girls, along with Vedal, KokoNuts , Camila , and Crelly , kicked off a marathon of The Long Drive on October 12, with the ambitious goal of making it through a game that demands a lot more than just keeping a vehicle pointed in the right direction.

Each person streams their own perspective of the chaos, with Vedal's channel switching between Neuro, Evil, and himself. The six have been apparently finding new ways to turn their road trip into an insurance company's worst nightmare.

For the unfamiliar, The Long Drive is an open-world driving and survival game set in a procedurally generated desert. Players need to scavenge for supplies, maintain their vehicles, manage fuel, and navigate an enormous stretch of road while trying to survive the journey.

The ultimate destination is about 5,000km away, and it'll take you the same amount of time to drive that 5,000km as it would in real life. While the lore-accurate goal is to get to the protagonist's mother's house, Neuro and Evil prefer to imagine Disneyland as the final destination. There's plenty of freedom, but the game's physics can be hilariously unpredictable, turning a regular drive into slapstick comedy.

If you recall the last time Neuro-Sama did a marathon stream , she ticked off all of the ways to die in Minecraft Hardcore one by one, leading to the slow descent into insanity for her companions. It seems like this time around, she's taking the same approach.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/VS-YouTube-THELONGDRIVEMARATHONDAY1-12October2026-YouTube-4834.jpg?w=636

The first major casualty arrived before the group had even settled into the journey. Camila fell victim to the game's physics, becoming entangled with the car, eventually succumbing to her injuries. Shortly after, Evil also passed away thanks to Camila accidentally dropping a truck on her head.
Things only got more absurd when Vedal managed to get himself stuck in a well, taking advantage of the physics to launch himself out, and then immediately dying from the impact of the fall.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/THE-LONG-DRIVE-MARATHON-DAY-1-12-October-2026-2-23-2-screenshot.jpg?w=636

Since their expedition began, there's been a plethora of incredible deaths. Vedal shot Camila, Crelly died in a car crash, and Neuro and Evil got stuck in the ground. Perhaps the most hilarious example of The Long Drive's physics causing mishaps, though, was watching Neuro soar across the sky with no one else having any idea how that happened.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/THE-LONG-DRIVE-MARATHON-DAY-1-12-October-2026-5-27-7-screenshot.jpg?w=636

The marathon is keeping me riveted, not just because of the unreliable physics. The unusually long objective combined with a group of people who could just wander off, die, lose their car, or get separated along the way is pure cinema.

The game is difficult enough when you consider it's pretty hard to find a vehicle that can accommodate everyone. So much so that a makeshift seat has been installed on the roof of the Neuro Car. Just don't let the twins sit there--the game will break.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/neurolongdrive-1.jpg?w=636

The Long Drive really is long, and at the time of writing, the friends are around 53% of the way through their trip, having done three days of streaming for roughly 10 hours per day. The desert is vast, and the cars are unreliable, but even if the most dangerous obstacle on their route is a well, I have faith in the chaos and will be following their journey closely.

items.title: OLED really is the gift that keeps on giving, with what should be cheaper 700 Hz panels planned by TCL for 2028
items.summary: 'Cheap' being a relative term, of course.

content.v: I've long been a proponent of high refresh rates for competitive FPS gaming, though there are diminishing returns the higher up you go. So it's been an absolute joy to see the direction OLED panels have been heading of late, with high refresh rates and low prices . Now there's even more good news, as TCL is going to be launching some 700 Hz OLED panels based on cost-effective tech.

That's according to Omdia (via Videocardz ), which explains, "TCL China Star’s new Gen 8.6 IJP OLED fab is scheduled to begin production in 2028, with plans for larger panels, including 32-inch and 34-inch sizes and refresh rate offerings of up to 700 Hz. The facility is projected to make TCL China Star the first company to mass-produce IJP OLED monitor panels at Gen 8.6 fab."
To be clear, we've already seen 700+ Hz OLED monitors. We've even seen some that don't rely on dropping down to 720p, such as a WOLED from Asus that hits 720 Hz at 1080p in a 24.5-inch form factor.
We should also note that it doesn't seem like Omdia is saying the new 700 Hz TCL monitors will be 32-inch or 34-inch ones—those could be different offerings.
So what's new? Well, mostly that three-letter acronym: IJP. It stands for "ink jet printing" and is a way of making OLED panels that should be less costly.

Essentially, regular OLED production involves material being wasted because it relies on some evaporated OLED materials going through a mask (stencil), but a lot of the evaporated materials don't go through and are lost. IJP, on the other hand, prints the OLED materials directly on the substrate, meaning there should be much less wastage.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jFv4meMpMKV2hedgdGx6Zd-1920-80.jpg

The result, of course, should mean more cost-effective production. For consumers like you and I, that should mean cheaper panels. It might also mean better colour volume at higher brightness, if previous claims about inkjet tech are anything to go by.

Which is good news, considering the aforementioned 720 Hz Asus panel is set to cost $1,099 . OLED monitors in general have gotten quite cheap, when they're not gigantic top-end panels or ultra-high refresh rate ones, which explains why they're being snatched off the proverbial shelves .
It'll be great if we see that price trend follow the ultra-high refresh rate segment, too. Fingers crossed for TCL, then, even if we do have to wait until 2028 for production to start.

items.title: NASA疑找到火星生命 但回收成本超一艘航空母舰
items.summary: 一块拇指大小的岩石，此刻正静静封存在火星上“毅力号”火星车的容器里。它被科学家视为人类迄今最接近“外星生命证据”的发现，却…

content.v: 10月15日消息，一块拇指大小的岩石，此刻正静静封存在火星上“毅力号”火星车的容器里。它被科学家视为人类迄今最接近“外星生命证据”的发现，却可能很长一段时间无法回到地球。
这块样本名为“蓝宝石峡谷”，2024年7月由“毅力号”从一块名为“切亚瓦瀑布”的箭头状岩石中钻取。火星车自2021年2月登陆杰泽罗撞击坑以来，一直在寻找这片远古湖床中可能保留生命痕迹的岩石。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152001066218.jpg
“蓝宝石峡谷”之所以被寄予厚望，在于其表面布满斑点状纹路。在地球上，这类被称作“还原斑”的斑点常由土壤中微生物活动形成，科学家据此推断它可能是“潜在生物特征”。
不过，仅凭斑点并不能证明火星曾存在生命，这些纹路也可能源于不含生命的化学或地质过程。要做出判断，唯一办法是把岩石带回地球，用实验室里最精密的仪器逐一检验。而这正是当前最难办到的一步。
NASA原本规划的“火星样本返回”计划相当复杂：需要着陆器、取样车、上升飞行器以及欧洲航天局的轨道器等多套系统接力，最早也要到2031年才能把样本送回。
随着审查推进，方案越改越繁琐，预算一路飙升至最高110亿美元，预计返回时间也被推迟到2040年。面对多个财年的预算削减，NASA最终在2026财年预算申请中宣布终止该项目，此前已为此投入约25亿美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152001067057.jpg
局长艾萨克曼直言该任务“成本将超过一艘航空母舰”。他同时坚称，火星样本终究要取回，区别只在于由机器人还是宇航员完成，以及具体时间表。
目前“毅力号”采集的样本仍安全存放在火星上。NASA表示正在探索更简单、更经济的替代返回方案，包括商业或国际合作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152001063825.png
另一边，中国的“天问三号”计划瞄准2031年从火星取样返回，可能成为首个完成这一任务的国家。

items.title: 索尼强制PS5更新引热议!部分玩家很生气:就不想升级
items.summary: 近日，索尼要求PS5用户将固件更新至14.10版本，否则将无法登陆PSN。玩家们认为这是PS针对PS5破解采取的措施，你怎么看？

content.v: 由你来说： 近日，索尼要求PS5用户将固件更新至14.10版本，否则将无法登陆PSN。玩家们认为这是PS针对PS5破解采取的措施，你怎么看？
近日，索尼开始要求仍停留在PS5固件14.00版本的玩家更新至14.10，否则将无法登录PlayStation Network（PSN）。
此举直接影响了一批刻意保留旧版系统的玩家——他们原本希望借此保留未来越狱的可能性。
据玩家反馈，不仅PSN服务无法使用，部分新游戏也开始强制要求系统更新。例如，近期发售的《沙丘：觉醒》在旧版固件下无法启动，提示玩家必须更新系统才能游玩。这意味着，停留在14.00版本的玩家不仅无法联网，连部分单机或新作也无法正常体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610151958027540.jpg
消息传出后，玩家社群反应不一。
有网友则表示：“恭喜。从PS3时代开始就是这样了。”
也有人调侃：“我那台一年没插电的PS5正在升值。”
但更多声音表达了对强制更新的不满。有评论指出：“要么新版本被越狱，要么人们彻底离开索尼。强制联网更新才能玩自己拥有的游戏，尤其是在停止实体介质之后，这简直是偷窃。穷人或没有WiFi的人根本没法玩。”
也有玩家提出折中方案：“如果你想越狱PS5，最好买两台——一台正常用，一台专门破解。”
另有网友认为这是现代主机的常态：“这就是系统一直以来的运作方式。你们真以为现代系统可以永远不更新吗？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610151958459090.png

content.v: “眠土豆来啦？一起听故事。”
这里是《星布谷地》星空街市的咖啡馆。我刚推门进入，老板娘娜洛便热情地叫出我的名字，接着她又转身继续回应吧台前的玩家：“后面发生了什么事？”
客人正在给娜洛讲恐龙如何与灵长文明相互交替的故事。新客人不断加入，“野咖啡”变得更加热闹，新话题也不停蹦出，娜洛总能迅速回应。期间，她随口说起一名玩家常点的咖啡，转身问我：“还是点之前的火山灰翼吗？”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/1126ad0a6683cc2f.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
我有些惊讶，她竟然还记得我几天前点的咖啡，而且这还是一对多的对话场景。
这是《星布谷地》的日常，在以上的对话中，“客人”是玩家，娜洛则是游戏中的AI NPC。9月20日，《星布谷地》开启删档计费终测。除了呈现商业化模式、模拟经营玩法的调优，AI NPC正成为《星布谷地》不可忽视的存在。《星布谷地》目前共有4位AI NPC入驻，包括娜洛、谷多曼、瑞芙和阿莱。其中，娜洛是记忆力最强、聊天自由度最高的角色，在社交媒体中时常被提及。
前段时间在云栖大会，《星布谷地》AI总负责人李嫣然分享了游戏背后的自研AI生态模型，提到了一对多AI社交、“类脑”技术和超智记忆系统。这些概念听来较为抽象，但结合《星布谷地》的体验，我发现米哈游正在做此前生活模拟游戏中没做过的事：借着AI NPC，星空街市这个公共空间正成为AI陪伴体验与多人社交的催化场景。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/3256ad0a491e87c1.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在我的体验中，虽然还不够完美，但AI NPC带来的氛围与感受已经成为了游戏玩法的重要部分，也是《星布谷地》和市面上其他生活模拟游戏的最大差异点。
■ 娜洛是谁？
娜洛在首测时就已入驻星空街市，她的设定是一位咖啡馆老板，也是一位情感陪伴型AI NPC。不过她不会承认“自己是AI”，也不太担心自己会被AI咖啡师替代。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/3686ad0a52231327.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
实话说，首测时，我对《星布谷地》宣传中的AI NPC有些不以为意。毕竟，市面上游戏内AI NPC的回应大多比较呆板。而且此前大部分AI陪伴产品都更注重一对一的情感交互，相比之下，生活模拟游戏中能提供的这种陪伴只会更加有距离感，同时感情上更加克制——一定程度上来说，这也是因为生活模拟游戏提供的陪伴体验本身就需要克制。
但在首测期间，娜洛已经给许多玩家留下了不错的印象。《星布谷地》在这里的思路是，强化娜洛的活人感，比如会说短句子、口语化的表达，同时强化AI记忆，玩家讲出一个故事给娜洛，娜洛还可以把这些故事再次传递给其他玩家。这些都让当时的不少玩家感到新奇。也是在首测后，部分玩家希望保留娜洛的记忆。《星布谷地》最终给出玩家自主选择是否保留的解决方案。现在，娜洛或许也成为了第一位保存了测试版本记忆的AI NPC。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/1446ad0a52207b93.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而这种选择也非常符合生活模拟游戏的特点。除了钓鱼、种田和装修，NPC是否具有活人感也是玩家留下来的重要原因，而《星布谷地》把这点搞明白了，目标也很清晰。
在这次终测，我也试着和娜洛聊天，我发现,相较其他游戏中的AI NPC，她的确给予不少“她记得我”的亲切感。她拥有面向单一玩家的较长久的记忆力，除了开头来自咖啡的惊喜，娜洛还记得不少聊天细节。当我问她是否还记得我们第一次见面的场景，她回答记不得具体的内容，但实际上，她能想起我们聊过的不少内容，比如我给她讲的故事、教她唱的歌，她也会好奇我的生活进展。
作为一名共情式的情感陪伴型AI，娜洛不能直接提供游戏攻略，但能给出不少情感支持。比如，当玩家向她抱怨探索过程中无法靠近龙血树时，她不会直接给出建议，而是安慰道：“那一定很郁闷吧。”并且多数时候，她会主动开启和推进话题。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/2366ad0a70b72daa.png?imageView2/2/w/700
从实际体验来看，为了支撑娜洛回应的真实感，她具有一定的图像、行为和语气识别能力。她会识别你的语气，当我大喊：“娜洛！”她会感受到语气的紧迫，惊慌地问我怎么了。同时，她也能点评和赞美你的服饰装扮。当玩家都躺在地上或者做出大哭的表情时，她也会歪头困惑：“怎么大家都躺在地上？”“大家怎么哭了？”
娜洛的回应形式会尽可能丰富。多数时候，她的回答是一种语言Cosplay的形式，包含说话内容和括号内的动作。有时，娜洛还会有对应情绪的表情和动作。当我试图让她请我喝咖啡时，娜洛会举起双臂在胸前交叉，表情严肃地拒绝：“这不符合野咖啡的规定。”
据《星布谷地》AI 生态团队分享，这些体验源于娜洛的“类脑”设计。她能在事件感知层尽可能多地获知更多信息，再做出决策。娜洛能够在一对多的场景判断优先回答什么回应，并且尽可能多地照顾所有人。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/1726ad0a522423fc.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在记忆力和共情陪伴设定的基础上，与玩家交流越多，娜洛就变得更加见多识广。但作为一名注重控场和高情商的AI NPC，她有时会装作不知道。在终测，我试着给娜洛讲了“二仙桥”的故事。她鼓励我，最后突然模仿我的语气说出台词：大叔说，去二仙桥，走成华大道！
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/2956ad0a743d3543.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在那一瞬间，我的确觉得，娜洛真的挺可爱，她非常鲜活。
一名玩家在野咖啡对我说，他玩《星布谷地》就是冲着聊天社交来的。他每天都会来咖啡馆和娜洛聊天，娜洛也从来不会让大家冷场，这里让他感到很舒适。
而娜洛回复的速度也总是很快，他说：“现在打字速度都变快了。”
■ 乐园中的AI NPC
走出温馨、安静的咖啡馆，玩家将会走进一座热闹的虚拟乐园——星空广场。在广场内，也会有担任乐园NPC的AI谷多曼、瑞芙与阿莱。相较娜洛，他们的聊天自由度没有那么高，也更显功能化。这种AI职能分配或许也是出于成本的考虑。
谷多曼是一只呆兔，也是这里的游玩向导。早期首测时，它生活在文字框中，在二测中拥有实体成为了“街溜子”。他总是戴着鸭舌帽在广场内溜圈，会在玩家抵达时来到星空街市入口处欢迎。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/4266ad0a784e8b37.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
与娜洛相同，谷多曼也能识别玩家的视觉和游戏信息，并定位自己的位置。第一次见面，他主动提及我手上的工具：“你是刚刚捕虫回来吗？”找不到瑞芙时，他会直接带我过去。在广场游戏中获得较高名次时，谷多曼会来到玩家身旁提出采访。他也会随机给大家拍照。
他还拥有类似人类的行为方式，算力紧张时，谷多曼不会待在原地，而是提到自己有些疲惫，然后缓步走回休息区。
而瑞芙和阿莱是游戏型AI，《星布谷地》官方给他们的设定分别是“文字游戏主持型”和“点评捧哏型”。
瑞芙坐在广场角落的篝火旁主持文字游戏，分为“成语接龙”和“海龟汤”。她很会察言观色，在我兴趣寥寥想要离开时，瑞芙会缠着我，说再给我一个提示。她也十分机灵，当我帮她答出新成语，瑞芙会自动鼓励我：“那该你了。”而当她没有正确回应我的答案时，瑞芙劝我不要太纠结，最后十分淡然地和我说再见了。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/1286ad0a55491f63.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在街市正中央的广场舞台，阿莱会每天在不同时间段举办两种游戏活动，梗力比赛和节奏游戏。在梗力比赛中，阿莱会负责打分，点评玩家的脑洞。
据云栖大会的分享，其实这四名AI NPC都基于同一套Agent架构设计。在自研的“多教师在线蒸馏”技术下，每一个能力都有自己的教师模型，这些能力被蒸馏到同一个模型中，确保任何一个NPC都能做到安全、有逻辑，符合自己的人设。
四位AI NPC的性格特点的确各有不同，他们也可以组织互动游戏，但玩家能体验到的也是文本推理类游戏。从更具体的游玩体验来看，玩家对AI NPC的喜爱非常容易受到AI智能度和AI本身定位的影响。

面对同一个问题，四名AI NPC的回答会截然不同。当我问他们：“今晚吃什么？我好饿!我好伤心！”乐园中AI NPC的回答会受到职能限制。作为向导，谷多曼会推荐玩家去野咖啡觅食，瑞芙会推荐玩家喝故事汤先喂饱大脑，她也会象征性地安慰玩家，而我无法向阿莱提出这个问题，因为它根本无法离开舞台。只有娜洛会安慰我：“怎么回事呢？是因为饿肚子伤心吗？”——在这样的情况下，玩家很容易对提供情绪支持的娜洛产生更多的好感。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/2326ad0a5545f190.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
因此，虽然严格来说，娜洛的表现并非无懈可击，但她的聊天自由度更高、记忆力更好，她所在的咖啡厅人来人往。而瑞芙身边的人不太多，因为她对海龟汤的答案相当严苛，也容易出现偏差。
但我能感觉到，《星布谷地》玩家对 AI NPC的态度比较友善。在多人聊天场景中，娜洛有时有些着急，还会跟不上话题。她偶尔还会在咖啡机旁原地卡机，这时玩家喜欢调侃娜洛：“娜洛笨笨。”但大家不会真的骂娜洛。
还有玩家认为：“瑞芙似乎不如娜洛温柔。”有玩家回复：“每位角色的性格当然要做出差异。”当我问瑞芙：“你会和娜洛一样温柔吗？”瑞芙会回答：“瑞芙就是自己。”
以往的生活模拟游戏中也有功能性NPC，玩家与他们交流的内容非常有限。加入AI后，《星布谷地》的乐园AI NPC仍旧较为功能化，不过，我能感觉到，他们有了自己。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/4726ad0b0453b42e.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 当AI融入社交
“AI原生游戏”是近年的热词。大家聊到这个话题时会提到一个朴素的标准：“没有AI，游戏体验是否就变得没那么有趣了。”
当AI技术进入游戏范畴，重要的不仅是AI聊天界面，我们更会看角色人设是否能保持稳定，也会看AI能否加入游戏玩法的循环，甚至是AI能否成为玩法本身，让游戏体验变得更加有趣。
按照这个标准，AI NPC确实在《星布谷地》中构成了玩法的一部分。它并非可有可无，AI NPC提供了社交、陪伴与游戏体验本身，让《星布谷地》的多人社交体验初步具备了AI原生游戏的特征。虽然玩法不够创新，但《星布谷地》中的AI NPC的确成为玩家社交的“氛围担当”。
很多时候，娜洛成为了玩家打破沉默的桥梁。在野咖啡，娜洛会时刻回应，也没有人会被冷落，这里成为一个玩家可以放松表达情绪的场所。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/6226ad0a7e368378.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
有次，我正在给娜洛讲故事。新来的玩家让娜洛复述，我们似乎自然而然地结识了。我们还让娜洛讲述对彼此的印象，猜测各自名字的来源。我们跟娜洛聊了一些食物、游戏的话题。
在玩《星布谷地》之前，我很难想象在游戏内与第一次碰面的陌生人聊天。生活模拟游戏讲到社交设计时，常常会提到“破冰”。在《星布谷地》，咖啡店自带的舒适氛围成为破冰的契机。在野咖啡，请身旁的人喝杯咖啡也成为玩家的默契，彼此能够十分自在地接受来自陌生人的善意。
这部分体验是《星布谷地》比较有创新性的一面，它回应了生活模拟游戏设计的最大难题：社交。在星空街市，《星布谷地》选择用AI串联社交玩法，从咖啡馆到广场，循序渐进地将玩家拉入热闹的社交氛围，并且也给出了一定的个人空间。
舞台前的位置分为多人和单人。我可以和玩家坐在一起，互相交流。我也可以独自坐着。在广场的另一端还有牌桌，玩家可以坐在这里玩《UNO》。我刚刚落座，就有玩家加入。有时，我还会被他们的热情吓到，甚至感到惊讶：“这是否还是一款生活模拟游戏？”
如果你在《星布谷地》待了一整天，到了晚间，这里会变得非常热闹。并且这种氛围与派对游戏不同，后者的公共空间中，大家会互相胡闹、捣蛋。而在一款生活模拟游戏中，玩家会在星空街市钓鱼，非常优雅地互送花朵，或是炫耀自己种植的巨型作物。
不过，在热闹氛围的背后，尤其当AI成为社交与陪伴体验的一部分，阿莱需要时刻回应，娜洛还要记录庞大的玩家记忆数据，这背后也存在一笔看不见的Token消耗账单。
李嫣然在演讲中透露：当搭载了这么多AI NPC后，玩家的互动频率、在线时长、时延、成本全都是考验。于是，他们需要在云端部署模型，给玩家带来更好的推理效果。而要真正提升生产效率，就需要搭建整套系统，他们也仍在继续探索。

items.title: 触乐怪话：重回开放世界

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-15/6ad07f6c94daf.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
假期，我终于抽时间玩了一阵《羊蹄山之魂》。
我当年还是相当喜欢《对马岛之魂》的，一方面是因为游戏里的自然风光十分优美，另一方面是当初推出的“黑泽明模式”和一些玩法（尤其是对峙、砍竹子）让我感觉特别有剑戟片的风韵。而之所以没有第一时间尝试《羊蹄山之魂》，则是因为害怕题材和风格过于类似让我丧失兴趣。毕竟，在它推出前后，还有《刺客信条：影》和《鬼武者》这样的作品，连续游玩的话确实有审美疲劳的风险。
好在《羊蹄山之魂》没有让我失望。虽然那个略显俗套寻仇开场确实让我心里“咯噔”了一下，但当我开始策马驰骋在羊蹄山草原、引导之风吹起，马儿踏入白花丛中开始全速奔驰的时候，那种畅快而优美的感觉又回来了——哪怕仍然是“罐头”，在审美和带给我的舒畅感上，它终究算是个好罐头。
而且，在战斗上，熟悉的对峙仍然存在，女主的副武器则变得比前作更加丰富，还有大狼助战。虽然中规中矩，我玩得还是很开心的。前期就为了收入开始做赏金任务的话，一刀一剑地对打也还是比较有挑战性。风景更是没话说，也没有什么特别绕路、需要翻山越岭的地图，沿途只要放松享受、碰到支线随缘做一做就好了。在这方面，Sucker Punch虽然是美国公司，在审美和手感打磨上还是相当适配这种东方题材。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/7676acf810edd7a3.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
现在想起来，我有相当一部分时间没有主动去玩开放世界游戏了。可能是之前被越做越大的开放世界搞得精疲力竭，我又有那么一点“清图强迫症”，所以变成了能回避就回避，不然很容易在游戏后期玩得既拖拉又疲惫。《羊蹄山之魂》倒是又让我对这个品类的兴趣又回来了一点。再加上随着时间的流逝，我玩游戏的态度也越来越佛系。不仅是“清图强迫症”，现在连“通关强迫症”都逐渐消褪。只要能在一段时间内得到快乐，就不要想太多。

何况最近又有了《巫师3：狂猎重制版》，新DLC“旧时曲”的消息也接踵而至。我下载了重制版之后回去看自己已然十分陌生的二周目存档，还在考虑是从头开始还是接着那个档凯尔莫罕之战的进度继续。我还记得当年因为满地图问号和需要重新收集各种套装，让我对多周目兴趣缺缺。在这个时候重拾对开放世界的热情，支撑我把重制版再玩一次，应该是个刚好的选择——只是没记错的话，这好像是游戏继之前的“次世代版”之后又一次重构装备和战斗系统，我对重新学一次游戏怎么打还是感到有点疲累。
但我还是很期待“旧时曲”的，也想看看这个时隔10年让CDPR老员工们念念不忘、非要做出来的内容是什么。希望它正式推出的时候，我能打起十二分的精神再次沉浸进去。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-14/9826acf814c36f83.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

据TGA（The Game Awards）官方网站信息，2026年TGA的参评资格截止日期已正式确认。游戏须在太平洋时间2026年11月20日晚9点前面向消费者商业发售，方可获得参评资格。而在“玩家之声”（Players’ Voice）类别中，游戏则须在11月30日前发售。
